datasets.title: Palestine - Gaza OSM Buildings Baseline (before October 7, 2023)
datasets.description: Dataset reflects digitization from January to July 2024 using imagery that was captured between 2019 and 2023. Data was obtained from a Geofabrik mirror dated January 1st 2025 (https://download.geofabrik.de/asia/israel-and-palestine.html), after Humanitarian OpenStreetMap Team's mapping initiative (https://wiki.openstreetmap.org/wiki/Gaza_Update_2024).. [Source: This metadata record was automatically extracted from the Humanitarian Data Exchange (HDX); Original dataset: https://data.humdata.org/dataset/gaza-osm-buildings-baseline-before-october-7-2023]
datasets.details: This data will not be updated, its rather the baseline for future reference.

lineage.description: Building footprints were digitized remotely from satellite imagery (2019-2023 capture dates) by the Humanitarian OpenStreetMap Team between January-July 2024. Data was extracted from a Geofabrik OpenStreetMap mirror dated January 1, 2025, representing the pre-October 7, 2023 baseline building stock in Gaza.
